meta.name: product-launch-video
meta.description: Turn a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch / promo video — SaaS promos, feature reveals, product demos, app and company launches. Use when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; the default for any commercial URL. Site tours / showcases of a website route here too — the brief carries the show-it-as-is intent. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把产品网址或一段文案变成产品发布宣传片

copy.tagline_en: Turn a product URL or brief into a launch promo video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a product to launch and need a promo video

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会按步骤把产品网址或脚本做成发布/宣传片：先抓取页面、定设计系统、写分镜与脚本，再逐帧生成画面，最后渲染出视频文件。
howto.when: 当你想推广、发布、宣传或展示某个产品时触发，也包括你粘贴脚本或简介；给它一个商业网址会默认走这条路，网站导览/展示也算。

howto.what_en: Claude runs a step-by-step workflow that turns a product URL, pasted script or brief into a launch or promo video: capture the site, set a design system, write a storyboard and script, build frames, and render an mp4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to market, launch, promote or reveal a product, including from a pasted script or brief; a commercial URL is the default, and site tours/showcases route here too.
